root.label: Cal/OSHA drafts emergency quartz countertop ban

events.label: Cal/OSHA drafts emergency quartz countertop ban

slots.name: crystalline silica limit
slots.sentence: On Sept. 16, Cal/OSHA put forth the draft of an emergency order to ban the manufacturing and fabrication (which means any form of altering, like drilling, sanding or cutting) of quartz countertops and similar products containing more than 1% crystalline silica.
